production_recommendation.selective_derivative_scope: explicit opt-in supplied JVP on independently qualified cases
production_recommendation.strict_return: available as exact observed-work comparison; current-window bound
production_recommendation.sentinel: explicit opt-in; not enabled as universal fastest policy

local_prs.title: Account for small Krylov arithmetic before extending the switcher's cost objective
local_prs.purpose: Resolve measured mismatch between callback work and total arithmetic: stiff-cubic W -10.95% but Ir +0.505%; reentrant mode Ir +145.02%.
derivation_contract: Derive operation/storage counts for safe norms, two-pass MGS, triangular or pivoted-QR updates as functions of n and Krylov dimensions.
Reuse existing Givens work where its residual/rank/stability preconditions hold; retain full-rank-deficient fallback and original residual validation.
For nonconstant callback costs use measured or supplied cost intervals; selection requires U_candidate+U_switch<L_incumbent, with provenance for each interval.
implementation_contract: Instrumentation is opt-in and preserves states, accepted/rejected decisions, callback and failure accounting.
Do not replace a verified algebraic residual with a fitted count model.
Unit weights remain named work-proxy fields; do not silently relabel them elapsed time.
validation_commands: cargo run -p vigilode --profile measurement --locked --example production_return_bench_20261027 -- reentrant-nonlinear rhs-only 16
required_artifacts: proof of operation counts and applicable rank/residual conditions
paired matched-accuracy timings including adverse cases
acceptance: Whole-trajectory work and time reported separately.
A proposed production promotion needs measured improvement on declared cases; retain losing alternatives.

local_prs.title: Bound exploration and residence loss across changing regimes
local_prs.purpose: Replace extrapolation from short-prefix fitness with a quantified online budget tied to usable cost bounds.
derivation_contract: Define replay-safe nonautonomous or augmented-autonomous model class and the temporal variation bound required to transport cost evidence.
Derive separate bounds for current productive-sentinel overhead and future residence/exploration loss.
Without an admissible future cost bound retain local comparison status and seek constructive current-window racing or budgeted continuation.
implementation_contract: Do not enable observed-step seed, smaller probe gaps or a new credit budget merely because one benchmark improves.
Every rejected/incomplete branch and counterfactual comparison remains charged.
Retain fatal priority and accepted physical checkpoint; avoid arbitrary cost margins.
validation_commands: cargo run -p vigilode --profile measurement --locked --example production_return_bench_20261027 -- all observed 1
required_artifacts: complete conditional theorem with constants and model assumptions
DAG from cost-bound inputs to routing decisions
actual nonlinear stiff/easy/reentrant regression and profiling
acceptance: Original20+16-arm evidence retained as historical control.
No claim of whole-trajectory optimality from one-window E<I.
Performance qualification includes RHS-only strong baseline.

local_prs.title: Transfer a winning explicit probe's complete native session
local_prs.purpose: Eliminate repeated DOPRI startup and workspace allocation after an accepted return without losing controller/FSAL identity.
derivation_contract: Specify owned or continuation-scoped session transfer preserving current state, FSAL vector, controller, accepted clock, schedule and epoch identity.
Prove the next trial is the same native continuation as if the winning probe had remained active.
implementation_contract: A state-plus-step snapshot does not satisfy complete session transfer.
Epoch mismatch, callback failure and budget exhaustion must refuse or preserve the accepted prefix with full work.
No callbacks after a fatal comparator.
acceptance: Equivalent native continuation or explicitly qualified rounding behavior.
No additional mathematical work to establish a cache hit.
Matched-accuracy timing includes session acquisition/transfer and failure paths.
